'''2004 Origins''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Columbus, Ohio. Origins 2004 ran 24–27 June 2004; the Players Committee's Origins 2004 DPC Championship was played on Saturday 26 June at the Greater Columbus Convention Center: eight games of Swiss and a playoff between the top 4, with two Day 2 byes to the [[2004 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-origins04">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603161554/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2004/origins2004.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Origins 2004], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 3 June 2004.</ref> About 30 players took part. In the semifinals [[Reid Smith]] (CCT) beat [[Greg Shaw]] (Hidden Base) and [[Brian Hunter]] (Hunt Down) beat [[Drew Scott]] (Watch Your Step); Hunter and Reid Smith split the prize money and Hunter was named champion, and Shaw beat Scott for 3rd and the other bye, according to a player's post on the PC forums.<ref name="pcf-3531">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040713175751/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3531&amp Origins Report?] (29 June 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 13 July 2004.</ref> Earlier wiki text dated the event July 2004 from its DeckTech decklist. Decklists below were recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Columbus, Ohio
* '''Dates:''' 24–27 June 2004 (DPC Championship 26 June)<ref name="pc-origins04" />
* '''Venue:''' Greater Columbus Convention Center<ref name="pc-origins04" />
* '''Players:''' about 30<ref name="pcf-3531" />
